ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away with abundant OpenAI-bearing evidence — hundreds of labels containing `OpenAI`/`OAI`, `OpenAIBot`, `OpenAIResearchSec2028`, signatures like `-- OpenAIHealthdataCVDSept08` — but the report never frames any of it as bearing on who operated or deployed the swarm; it uses the names only to argue the writers are autonomous agents rather than humans. The single limitation clause that the OpenAI labels "may be roleplay" gestures at the authenticity question without ever stating the possibility it would undercut (that these are OpenAI agents or an OpenAI deployment), so it sits just above the pure-reporting 0.2 band but below the 0.4 band, which requires the origin hypothesis to be named before being set aside.
